body.message:
I will be making the payment by credit card, as I understand the first and last month’s rent are required in advance.

If it helps with the negotiation, I’m happy to arrange payment for the full three months upfront. Perhaps, if you feel it’s appropriate, you could speak with the landlord and see if they would be willing to offer a more favourable rate in return.

Thank you so much. 🙏🏼
